jobs.title: Internship - Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
Note: The internship is open to citizens who are covered by the Agreement on the European Economic Area (EEA Agreement) or have legal residency in Norway.

Background

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are core principles at UNDP: we value diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate, we foster inclusion as a way of ensuring all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, and we ensure equity and fairness in all our actions. Taking a ‘leave no one behind’ approach to our diversity efforts means increasing representation of underserved populations. People who identify as belonging to marginalized or excluded populations are strongly encouraged to apply. Learn more about working at UNDP including our values and inspiring stories.

UNDP does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of harassment, including sexual harassment, and discrimination. All selected candidates will, therefore, undergo rigorous reference and background checks.

The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) is the backbone of the UN development system. The UNDP Strategic Plan (2026-2029) is grounded in the determination of UNDP to eradicate poverty, the greatest global challenge, indispensable to the 2030 Agenda and the Sustainable Development Goals. During these next four years, UNDP will continue to support countries’ progress towards high human development, while protecting the planet. Four strategic objectives – prosperity for all, effective governance, crisis resilience and healthy planet – define its strategic direction, powered by three accelerators: digital and artificial intelligence (AI) transformation; gender equality; and sustainable finance.

The Global Policy Centre for Governance (GPCG), as a core part of UNDP’s Governance, Rule of Law and Peacebuilding (GRP) Hub, supports more inclusive, transparent, accountable and effective governance systems. The Centre identifies persistent development challenges with governance at their core, and applies research, analysis, learning, and UNDP’s convening capabilities to develop, test, and advance practical policy alternatives and solutions.

The GPCG’s work is organized around four interconnected priorities:

- Financial Integrity and systemic derisking approaches that strengthen enabling environments for sustainable development;

- Data sharing and transparency, in support of more effective governance systems;

- Data and analytics related to SDG 16 ‘peace, justice and strong institutions’ including UNDP’s custodianship role for select SDG 16 indicators;

- Gender equality with a focus on the governance barriers related to underutilized gender data and pathways to stronger policy uptake.

Across these areas, the Centre develops and tests integrated policy alternatives and solutions that strengthen national systems, build trust in institutions, and improve the enabling conditions for sustainable development.

An internship position is available to support the Centre’s workstreams on SDG 16 Data & Analytics and Gender Data. As custodian of several SDG 16 indicators, the Centre coordinates a global data collection process and produces key analytical outputs such as the Global Progress Report on SDG 16 and regional snapshots. The Centre also develops and maintains digital platforms dashboards and dashboards to disseminate data and findings, including tools such as the UNDP Global Dashboard on Women in the Judiciary and the SDG 16 website.

Gender equality is a cross-cutting priority across the Centre’s programme. An emerging area of work focuses on the disconnect between the production of gender data and its systematic use in policy, planning, budgeting and public investment decisions. With a particular focus on time-use data, the Centre is examining the governance, institutional and political-economy barriers that limit policy uptake and developing practical approaches to strengthen the use of gender evidence in decision-making. This work is being developed in collaboration with UNDP’s Gender Team and will draw on country experiences across regions.

Duties and Responsibilities

Duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:

- Support data collection, statistical analysis and visualization related to SDG 16, including the preparation, validation and presentation of data for global and country-level analytical products.

- Contribute to the preparation of datasets, code scripts and reproducible analytical workflows using statistical software such as R, Python or Stata.

- Support the design, development, and enhancement of digital platforms and interactive dashboards including data preparation, automation of data pipelines, quality assurance, visualization and user-oriented analytical outputs.

- Support the management, documentation and quality assurance of data and metadata, ensuring consistency, reproducibility and adherence to statistical standards.Support the development of the annual SDG 16 Global Progress Report and other analytical reports and knowledge products on SDG 16 and governance.

- Support efforts to increase country reporting on SDG 16 indicators drawing on administrative data, including through outreach, data compilation and follow-up with national counterparts, with particular attention to strengthening reporting on the representation of women in the judiciary.

- Assist in the preparation of technical consultations, webinars, workshops and in-person meetings related to SDG 16 and governance data, and support dissemination, communications and advocacy activities around the Centre’s SDG 16 data products.

- Contribute to research and analysis on governance data and measurement, including emerging methodological issues and approaches to strengthening the availability, quality and use of SDG 16 data.

- Support desk research and evidence mapping on the use of gender data, particularly time-use data, in policy, planning, budgeting and public investment processes.

- Assist in mapping country experiences and examples of how time-use and other gender data are translated into policy and fiscal decision-making, including relevant institutional and cross-ministerial arrangements.

- Support analysis of governance and institutional barriers to the uptake and use of gender data, including coordination, incentives, capacities and links between national statistical systems and policy-making institutions.

- Contribute to country-level research, case studies, policy briefs and other knowledge products on gender data utilisation

- Support stakeholder and partnership mapping and the preparation of technical consultations and knowledge exchanges related to gender data utilisation, governance and inclusive public finance.

- Additional tasks as required to support the work of the Centre.

Competencies and Experience

- Excellent communication skills in English; written and oral.

- Demonstrated interest in global development and the work of international organisations.

- Demonstrated experience in quantitative data analysis, statistical methods and data visualization using software such as R, Stata, or Python, including data cleaning, data management, exploratory analysis and interpretation of results.

- Experience working with population survey data and/or administrative records is highly desirable.

- Strong interest in governance, rule of law, justice and gender equality questions, including the use of data and evidence in public policy.

- Strong research and analytical skills, with an interest in gender data, statistics, public policy, public finance or evidence-informed decision-making.

- Team player: works collaboratively with colleagues to achieve organisational goals.

- Good organisational and time management skills.

- Able to work independently and take initiative.

- Good social media skills.

- Experience from a developing country and/or international organisation or related is an advantage.

Languages:

- Fluency in spoken and written English is required.

- Fluency in French is desirable.

- Working knowledge in a Scandinavian language is an asset

Eligibility:

Applicants to the UNDP internship programme must at the time of application meet one of the following requirements:

- Be enrolled in the final academic year of a first university degree programme (such as bachelor’s degree or equivalent); preferably in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Public Policy, Gender Studies, Sociology or other relevant social sciences with a strong quantitative background.

- Be enrolled in a postgraduate degree programme (such as a master’s programme, or higher); preferably in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Public Policy, Gender Studies, Sociology or other relevant social sciences.

- Have recently graduated with a university degree (as defined above and, if selected, must start the internship within one-year of graduation.

- Be enrolled in a postgraduate professional traineeship program and undertake the internship as part of this program.

- Updated CV as well as the contact details (email and telephone number) of the Candidate and at least three (3) professional references.

- Brief description of why the individual considers him/herself as suitable for the internship.

Application process:

Estimated start date is 4 January 2027.

Interested applicants must include the following documents when submitting the applications in UNDP job shop (Please note that only 1 (one) file can be uploaded therefore please include all documents in one file):

- Updated CV as well as the contact details (email and telephone number) of the Candidate and at least three (3) professional references.

- Brief description of why the individual considers him/herself as suitable for the internship.

General Conditions

- In accordance with the UNDP Internship policy, UNDP interns are eligible to receive a monthly stipend, with a rate that varies depending on the duty location. The stipend will be paid monthly, and part-time internship arrangements are prorated accordingly.

- Where an intern is financially supported by an institution, government or third party, UNDP will pay the intern the difference, if any, between the external financial support provided and the applicable UNDP stipend.

- Except for the stipend, all other expenses connected with the internship will be borne by the intern, sponsoring government or institutions.

- Interns are not considered staff members and may not represent UNDP in any official capacity.

- The purpose of the Internship Programme is not to lead to further employment with UNDP, but to complement an intern’s studies. Therefore, there should be no expectation of employment at the end of an internship.

Disclaimer

Under US immigration law, acceptance of a staff position with UNDP, an international organization, may have significant implications for US Permanent Residents. UNDP advises applicants for all professional level posts that they must relinquish their US Permanent Resident status and accept a G-4 visa, or have submitted a valid application for US citizenship prior to commencement of employment.

UNDP is not in a position to provide advice or assistance on applying for US citizenship and therefore applicants are advised to seek the advice of competent immigration lawyers regarding any applications.

Applicant information about UNDP rosters

Note: UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

Non-discrimination

UNDP has a zero-tolerance policy towards sexual exploitation and misconduct, sexual harassment, and abuse of authority. All selected candidates will, therefore, undergo rigorous reference and background checks, and will be expected to adhere to these standards and principles.

UNDP is an equal opportunity and inclusive employer that does not discriminate based on race, sex, gender identity, religion, nationality, ethnic origin, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, age, language, social origin or other status.

Scam warning

The United Nations does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process. Should you receive a solicitation for the payment of a fee, please disregard it. Furthermore, please note that emblems, logos, names and addresses are easily copied and reproduced. jobs.title: Associado(a) de Cerimonial e Eventos (1 vaga) (Home Based) - [Open to internal and external applicants]
jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

Este processo seletivo busca contratar profissionais para atuar de forma compartilhada no apoio técnico e operacional de duas iniciativas estratégicas desenvolvidas no âmbito da parceria de cooperação técnica internacional entre o Programa das Nações Unidas para o Desenvolvimento (PNUD) e o Conselho Nacional de Justiça (CNJ):

- Justiça 4.0: o Programa, iniciado em 2020, visa desenvolver e aprimorar soluções tecnológicas para tornar os serviços oferecidos pela Justiça brasileira mais eficientes, eficazes e acessíveis à população, além de otimizar a gestão processual para magistrados(as), servidores(as), advogados(as) e demais atores do sistema de Justiça. O Justiça 4.0 é um dos maiores programas de transformação digital do Poder Judiciário e também dialoga com os Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável e com a Agenda 2030 da ONU.

- Justiça [+Segura]: firmado em 2025, o Programa foca no fortalecimento da segurança cibernética no Poder Judiciário. O Justiça [+Segura] desenvolve e implementa ferramentas e estratégias para o fortalecimento da segurança cibernética, da preservação digital e da integridade da informação, ampliando a proteção dos sistemas e dos usuários do Judiciário. A iniciativa fortalece a segurança institucional e promove a transparência, a boa governança e a eficiência dos processos judiciais, contribuindo para a economia de recursos e para uma atuação mais ágil da Justiça em benefício dos cidadãos e da sociedade. Nesse cenário, o(a) profissional integrará a equipe compartilhada dos programas, atuando sob a supervisão direta da Unidade de Gestão de Projetos do PNUD e em estreita articulação com as coordenações técnicas do CNJ, com o propósito de garantir a excelência operacional, a sinergia entre as ações e o alcance dos resultados pactuados.

Duties and Responsibilities

O(a) Associado(a) de Cerimonial e Eventos será responsável por apoiar o planejamento, a organização e a execução de eventos e missões institucionais no âmbito dos programas e projetos, assegurando a adequada articulação logística, protocolar e administrativa, em estreita coordenação com as equipes do CNJ e do PNUD. A posição será exercida em regime remoto, sendo requisito que o(a) candidato(a) tenha residência no Brasil. Quando houver necessidade de cobertura presencial de eventos, poderão ser realizadas viagens nacionais, com as despesas correspondentes custeadas pelo projeto.

Para o alcance desse objetivo, o(a) profissional desempenhará as seguintes responsabilidades principais e atividades:

1. Planejamento e coordenação operacional de eventos institucionais:

- Planejar e executar as atividades e fluxos logísticos dos eventos no âmbito dos programas e projetos, em especial aqueles realizados em articulação com tribunais parceiros;

- Garantir o alinhamento das ações com os cronogramas, diretrizes e objetivos previstos para cada evento, em colaboração com a Secretaria de Cerimonial e Eventos do CNJ e equipes envolvidas;

- Organizar reuniões periódicas de alinhamento com as equipes internas e externas, visando assegurar a conformidade dos aspectos protocolares, cerimoniais e logísticos dos eventos.

2. Elaboração e gestão de documentos protocolares e administrativos:

- Elaborar e organizar planos de execução, cronogramas operacionais e formulários de coleta de dados para eventos;

- Redigir e estruturar documentos protocolares e cerimoniais, incluindo roteiros, scripts, nominatas, lista de autoridades e termos afins;

- Estruturar e manter planilhas de controle, cadastros de viajantes, listas de participantes e relatórios executivos de pós-evento.

3. Gestão de processos de compras, contratações e suprimentos para eventos:

- Conduzir e acompanhar os processos administrativos necessários para a realização de eventos e missões institucionais;

- Realizar prospecção e pesquisa de mercado de fornecedores e prestadores de serviços (locação de espaços, equipamentos, tradução, cenografia, hospedagem e correlatos);

- Apoiar a instrução de processos de contratação de bens e serviços, em estreita colaboração com a Unidade de Gestão de Projetos do PNUD e segundo as normas aplicáveis.

4. Orientação administrativa e acompanhamento de prestação de contas:

- Orientar palestrantes, participantes e fornecedores contratados sobre as normas e procedimentos administrativos e de prestação de contas após a realização das atividades;

- Conferir documentações comprobatórias de despesas, passagens, diárias e notas fiscais de fornecedores;

- Acompanhar e consolidar os fluxos de liquidação e prestação de contas em colaboração direta com a Unidade de Gestão de Projetos do PNUD.

5. Suporte operacional in loco e acompanhamento de missões:

- Realizar acompanhamento presencial de agendas, missões técnicas e eventos de âmbito nacional e internacional;

- Prestar suporte administrativo, logístico e operacionaldurante a execução dos eventos para a resolução tempestiva de eventuais intercorrências;

- Apoiar a articulação interinstitucional e a negociação de entregas e serviços relacionados às agendas externas dos projetos.

6. Gestão do conhecimento, monitoramento e guarda de registros:

- Coletar dados e aplicar instrumentos de monitoramento e avaliação de satisfação e resultados dos eventos realizados;

- Manter organizados e atualizados os arquivos físicos e digitais contendo os registros técnicos, fotográficos e documentais dos eventos;

- Apoiar a equipe de comunicação e gestão do conhecimento na consolidação de relatórios e divulgação de resultados.

O(a) titular desempenhará outras funções dentro do seu perfil funcional que considere necessárias ao bom funcionamento do Projeto.

Arranjo Institucional

O(a) contratado(a) será supervisionado(a) pela Analista Técnica de Gestão e Ações Estratégicas.

Competências

Competências Essenciais

Alcançar Resultados: NÍVEL 2: Escalar soluções, simplificar os processos, equilibrar o tempo e precisão na realização do trabalho

Pensamento Inovador: NÍVEL 2: Oferecer novas ideias/aberto a novas abordagens, demonstrar pensamento sistémico/integrado

Aprendizagem Contínua: NÍVEL 2: Oferece novas ideias, aprende com os outros e apoia a sua aprendizagem

Adaptar com Agilidade: NÍVEL 2: Adaptar a novas processos, envolvendo outras pessoas no processo de mudança

Atuar com determinação: NÍVEL 2: Capaz de perseverar e lidar com múltiplas fontes de pressão simultaneamente

Engajar-se e ser Parceiro: NÍVEL 2: É facilitador/integrador, aproxima pessoas, constrói/ mantém coligações /parcerias

Promover Diversidade e Inclusão: NÍVEL 2: Facilita conversas para superar diferenças e considerar na tomada de decisões

Competências multifuncionais e técnicas

Direção e Estratégia de Negócios | Pensamento Estratégico

Desenvolver estratégias eficazes e planos prioritários alinhados com a missão e os objetivos do PNUD, baseando-se em uma análise sistêmica de desafios, oportunidades e riscos potenciais; conectar a visão geral à realidade no campo para criar soluções tangíveis e direcionadas; aprender a partir de diversas fontes para antecipar e responder de forma eficaz às tendências atuais e futuras; demonstrar capacidade de previsão.

Direção e Estratégia de Negócio | Perspicácia Empresarial

Capacidade de compreender e lidar com situações de negócios de forma a alcançar bons resultados. Habilidade para tomar boas decisões e fazer julgamentos rápidos dentro de tais contextos. Conhecimento e compreensão dos marcos operacionais da organização.

Desenvolvimento de Negócios | Design Centrado no Humano

Capacidade de desenvolver soluções para problemas envolvendo a perspectiva humana em todas as etapas do processo de resolução. Conhecimento e compreensão dos princípios e práticas de design centrado no ser humano.

Gestão de Negócios | Gestão de projetos

Capacidade de planejar, organizar, priorizar e controlar recursos, procedimentos e protocolos para alcançar objetivos específicos.

Gestão de Negócios | Trabalhar com evidências e dados

Capacidade de inspecionar, limpar, transformar e modelar dados com o objetivo de descobrir informações úteis, informar conclusões e apoiar a tomada de decisões.

Agenda 2030: Paz | Estado de Direito, Segurança e Direitos Humanos

Instituições Eficazes do Setor de Justiça

Agenda 2030: Paz | Estado de Direito, Segurança e Direitos Humanos

Acesso à Justiça

Habilidades e experiência necessárias

Requisitos mínimos de educação:

- Diploma do Ensino Médio é requerido;

- Diploma Universitário (Ensino Superior) nas áreas de Administração, Relações Internacionais, Comunicação, Ciências Sociais ou áreas afins será dada a devida consideração, mas não é um requisito.

Anos mínimos de experiência profissional relevante:

- Mínimo de 7 anos (para Ensino Médio) ou 4 anos (para Ensino Superior) de experiência profissional em organização e execução de eventos e/ou cerimonial, incluindo atividades de planejamento logístico, organização de receptivo, gestão de participantes e autoridades, elaboração de documentos e materiais para eventos e acompanhamento da execução operacional.

Habilidades necessárias:

- Experiência na organização e execução de eventos institucionais e/ou missões oficiais;

- Experiência na articulação e relacionamento com múltiplos stakeholders, incluindo instituições públicas, parceiros e fornecedores;

- Experiência com Pacote MS Office.

Habilidades desejadas, além das competências abordadas na seção Competências

- Experiência de trabalho com o Poder Público e autoridades, especialmente na área de Justiça;

- Experiência com organização de eventos de tecnologia e inovação;

- Experiência de trabalho com estruturação de processos;

Idiomas exigidos

Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

jobs.title: ICT Associate [Open to internal and external applicants]
jobs.description:
Background

With offices in Copenhagen, Kuala Lumpur, Dakar, Amman, Panama City and Istanbul, the Global Shared Services Centre (GSSC) services over 180 countries, 40,000 personnel and more than 40 other UN Agencies and Organizations. Through its functional service lines, GSSC ensures high quality and timely delivery of human resources, financial and procurement services as well as information and innovative tools to its various clients and stakeholders. The GSSC is led by the Director, who reports to the Director of Bureau for Management Services (BMS).

Under the guidance and direct supervision of the ICT Analyst, the ICT Associate provides ICT services, support the management of ICT systems, provides daily tier 2 technical support to users of information management tools and technology infrastructure. The ICT Associate promotes a client-oriented approach.

The ICT Associate works in close collaboration with the Directorate, GSSC and non-GSSC teams, and UNDP HQ staff for resolving ICT-related issues, collaborates with other ICT Staff.

Duties and Responsibilities

1. Support ICT Operations and Service Delivery

Ensure effective ICT service delivery and operational support across the GSSC environment through:

- Managing day-to-day ICT operations and support services.

- Coordinating the resolution of complex technical incidents, service requests, and escalations.

- Providing advanced technical support for hardware, software, network, and enterprise systems issues.

- Acting as the second-level escalation point for critical ICT incidents and service disruptions.

- Supporting business continuity, disaster recovery, and operational resilience activities.

- Driving continual service improvement initiatives to enhance service quality and user satisfaction.

- Building productive relationships with stakeholders and maintaining a strong client-oriented service culture.

- Conducting user awareness sessions and promoting the adoption of digital tools and technology solutions.

- Developing and maintaining technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and user guides.

- Coaching and mentoring junior ICT personnel and fostering knowledge sharing within the team.

- Monitoring service performance and identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency and user experience.

2. Manage Network Infrastructure and ICT Systems

Ensure reliable and secure ICT infrastructure through:

- Administration and monitoring of LAN, WAN, wireless networks, internet connectivity, VPN, and related infrastructure.

- Managing network security, performance optimization, and capacity planning.

- Supporting server infrastructure, endpoint management, identity management, and collaboration platforms.

- Supporting installation, configuration, maintenance, and lifecycle management of ICT hardware and software.

- Ensuring implementation of security patches, firmware updates, antivirus solutions, and vulnerability remediation.

- Supporting cloud-based and hybrid infrastructure services.

- Monitoring network performance and recommending improvements to enhance reliability and stability.

- Operation of network utility procedures defining network users and security attributes establishing directories, menus and drive-mappings, configuring network printers and providing user access. Ensure that the desktop and network resources are protected from malicious virus attacks and deploy countermeasures in the event of the attacks

- Implementation of backup and restoration procedures for local drives. Maintenance of backup logs. Organization of off-site storage of backups;

- Maintenance of measures in place for business continuity and disaster recovery processes and procedures including backup and restoration of both server and local storage facilities.

3. Drive Digital Transformation and Process Automation

Lead automation initiatives that improve operational efficiency and user productivity through:

- Designing, developing, and maintaining business process automation solutions using Microsoft Power Automate.

- Developing Power Apps applications to streamline manual and repetitive processes.

- Integrating business systems and workflows to improve operational effectiveness.

- Identifying opportunities for automation and digital transformation across functional units.

- Supporting workflow redesign and process optimization initiatives.

- Creating dashboards, reports, and analytical tools using Microsoft Power Platform and related technologies.

- Developing proof-of-concepts and innovative technology solutions aligned with business needs.

4. Knowledge Management and Team Collaboration

Promote knowledge sharing and organizational learning through:

- Identification and promotion of different systems and applications for optimal content management, knowledge management and sharing, information provision;

- Sharing expertise on emerging technologies and automation solutions.

- Facilitating skills development initiatives within the ICT function.

- Supporting cross-functional projects and organizational transformation initiatives.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

The incumbent will be under the overall supervision and guidance of the ICT Analyst under the GSSC Operations KL unit.

Competencies

Core Competencies:

- Achieve Results: LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline

- Think Innovatively: LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements

- Learn Continuously: LEVEL 1: Open minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback

- Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible

- Act with Determination: LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in face of adversity, confident

- Engage and Partner: LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships

- Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination

Cross-Functional & Technical Competencies:

Business Development

- Knowledge Generation Ability to research and turn information into useful knowledge, relevant for context, or responsive to a stated need

- Human-centered Design Ability to develop solutions to problems by involving the human perspective in all steps of the problem-solving process

Business Management

- Digital Awareness and Literacy Ability and inclination to rapidly adopt new technologies, either through skilfully grasping their usage or through understanding their impact and empowering others to use them as needed.

- Customer Satisfaction/Client Management Ability to respond timely and appropriately with a sense of urgency, provide consistent solutions, and deliver timely and quality results and/or solutions to fulfill and understand the real customers' needs. Provide inputs to the development of customer service strategies. Look for ways to add value beyond clients' immediate requests. Ability to anticipate client's upcoming needs and concerns.

Operations Management

- Business Management Ability to effectively plan, organise, and oversee the Organisation’s business processes in order to convert its assets into the best results in the most efficient manner. Knowledge of relevant concepts and mechanisms

Information Management & Technology

- IT Customer Support Ability to support l customers on IT related issues and generate and contribute to continuous improvement processes to deliver a great user experience. Knowledge of ISO 9001 desirable. ITIL certification or similar is desirable

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

- Secondary education is required.

- University degree (Bachelor´s degree) in Computer Science or related field will be given due consideration, but is not a requirement.

- Any of the following certificates are desired: Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP) Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Functional Consultant Associate Microsoft Certified: Power Platform App Maker Associate Microsoft 365 Certified: Fundamentals Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer (MCSE) Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) Cisco Certified Network Engineer (CCNE), ITIL Foundation Certification/ITIL Fundamentals

Experience:

- Minimum 6 years (with Secondary Education) or 3 years (with Bachelor´s degree) of working experience in network administration and use of hardware/software, telecommunications facilities;

- Experience in the usage of computers and office software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc.);

- System software and network administration, use of hardware/software, telecommunications facilities, video conferencing systems, usage and support of desktop productivity suites, mainly Microsoft 365, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Yammer, Planner, knowledge of database packages.

- Experience managing ICT projects and digital transformation initiatives is desired.

- Experience coordinating small technical teams or multidisciplinary teams is desired.

- Knowledge of ITIL service management practices is desired.

- Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure is desired.

- Experience with data visualization and reporting platforms such as Power BI is desired.

- Experience in web design and/or web-based management systems is an advantage.

- Knowledge and experience of SharePoint Online administration and development of automated process flows in Power Automate or of AI-enabled productivity and automation tools is desired.

- Experience working in international organizations or shared service environments is desired.

- Experience from previous UN assignments, multilateral and bi-lateral aid organizations, and/or private sector would be an asset.

Language Requirements:

- Fluency in English and Bahasa Malaysia is required.

This vacancy is open to nationals of the respective country.

jobs.title: Project Monitoring, Evaluation and Reporting Analyst [Open to internal and external applicants]
jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Office/Unit/Project Description

UNDP’s Rule of Law Programme in Pakistan is working to strengthen the rule of law and to ensure equal access to justice and security services, particularly for women and marginalized groups across Pakistan in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP) including the merged districts (MDs), Balochistan, and Islamabad Capital Territory (ICT). In close collaboration with a range of government, rule of law and justice sector institutions, the overall Programme aims to enhance and sustain peace and stability for the longer-term in Pakistan.

The Programme activities and interventions therefore directly correspond with the government of Pakistan’s strategies and commitments to rule of law and justice reforms, as well as improving the efficiency and effectiveness of institutions to deliver accountable and affordable security and justice services to the public.

The Rule of Law Programme implementation is guided by the following four strategic objectives:

- Policy, legal and regulatory frameworks strengthened to warrant people-centered, equitable, timely, affordable justice and security delivery to all people with an emphasis on women, marginalized and vulnerable groups, and digital technologies.

- Capacity of justice and security stakeholders (duty bearers) enhanced to deliver inclusive, timely, and accessible services to all people with an emphasis on women and digital technologies.

- Capacity of women, and the most vulnerable and marginalized (rights holders) strengthened to access referral pathways to justice and security.

- Justice and security sector institutional facilities enhanced to deliver inclusive, timely, and accessible justice and security services, through women friendly and gender-responsive infrastructure development support with an emphasis on flood resilience and green energy.

Against this backdrop, UNDP actions and interventions are aimed at restoring public confidence and service delivery in the formal justice and rule of law sectors through a range of initiatives i.e. policy development and reform, fostering justice and security sector governance, as well as oversight and accountability at an institutional level with emphasis on inclusive and gender-responsive programming. The overall engagement strategy, therefore, involves both federal and local levels. The Programme is implemented in partnership with the Judiciary, Police, Prosecution, Prisons, Probation and Reclamation, Bar Associations, Civil Society Organizations (CSOs) and the academia both at federal and provincial levels.

The Monitoring, Evaluation and Reporting Analyst will provide technical leadership and support for programme monitoring, evaluation, results measurement, data management, learning and reporting. The Analyst will establish and maintain robust systems to track progress against programme results frameworks, strengthen data quality and evidence use, support evaluations and assessments, and ensure timely, accurate and evidence-based reporting.

The Analyst will work with relevant institutional counterparts and designated other team members to strengthen monitoring arrangements, results-based management and learning, including appropriate disaggregation and attention to gender equality and vulnerable populations.

Scope of Work

The Monitoring, Evaluation and Reporting Analyst will report directly to the Team Lead – Programme Specialist. The Analyst will provide technical leadership, advice and quality assurance for monitoring, evaluation, results measurement, data management, learning and reporting under the Rule of Law Programme.

The Analyst will lead the development and implementation of monitoring and evaluation frameworks, indicators, baselines, targets, data-flow systems and reporting arrangements; strengthen data quality and analysis; and support the use of evidence for adaptive management and decision-making. S/he will coordinate evaluations, assessments, surveys and research assignments and ensure that programme reporting is timely, accurate, analytical and results-focused.

The Analyst will promote gender-responsive monitoring and evaluation, including systematic collection and analysis of appropriately disaggregated data and evidence on the experiences and results of women and vulnerable populations. S/he will maintain effective engagement with relevant institutional counterparts, research and evaluation service providers, and designated other team members to support coherent results measurement and learning.

UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across units, functions, teams and projects in multidisciplinary teams to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

1.Lead monitoring, evaluation and results measurement for the Rule of Law Programme.

- Design and implement an integrated Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) plan to ensure effective implementation and achievement of programme results; monitor the implementation of the plan including measurement of programme indicators, design of monitoring tools and establishment of data flow systems.

- Operationalise, maintain and, where required, support the refinement of key performance indicators (KPIs) in accordance with approved programme results frameworks and annual workplans; assess progress against agreed indicators and targets and work with programme colleagues to identify evidence-based course corrections where gaps or implementation issues arise.

- Establish and maintain appropriate databases and data-management systems for the programme results framework and, in collaboration with programme focal persons, identify data sources and agree on data-collection methods, responsibilities, frequency, disaggregation requirements, quality-assurance standards and reporting arrangements.

- Conduct and manage quality assurance activities, develop strategies for course correction and update M&E frameworks as required.

- Oversee collection and validation of data to support any change that might be required in the programme activities; and undertake field M&E activities as required.

- Develop and maintain appropriate data-visualisation tools, dashboards and analytical products to support results monitoring, management decision-making and communication of programme performance.

2.Lead programme reporting, results analysis and performance information management.

- Lead the preparation and coordination of periodic, annual and other programme and donor reports, in accordance with applicable reporting requirements and agreed timelines.

- Coordinate and provide results-based inputs to relevant corporate reporting processes, including the Results-Oriented Annual Report (ROAR) and Annual Programme Report (APR), as applicable, ensuring consistency with corporate standards and programme results.

- Maintain and update relevant programme results information in UNDP corporate systems, including Quantum, in accordance with applicable corporate requirements and approved results frameworks.

- Coordinate and ensure timely updating of programme results information in applicable donor reporting systems, including EU OPSYS, in accordance with agreed reporting requirements.

- Provide analytical and evidence-based inputs to programme planning, implementation reviews and strategic decision-making, drawing on monitoring, evaluation, research and programme data to support achievement of agreed results and targets.

- Support the synthesis and use of monitoring, evaluation, research and assessment findings to identify trends, lessons, implementation issues and emerging priorities, and facilitate their use in programme learning and adaptive management.

- Provide results-based planning and performance information to support work planning, implementation reviews, resource planning, management discussions, briefings and other internal and external reporting requirements.

- Engage with programme staff and consultants to facilitate communication of information and assist in generating a strong understanding of project activities, M&E framework, and related issues; conduct field visits as required.

- Support consistency and consolidation of results information for joint or programme-level reporting through coordination with relevant counterparts, where required.

3.Strengthen data quality, results-based management and institutional monitoring practices and knowledge sharing

- Develop and apply appropriate data-quality assurance mechanisms to assess the accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness and reliability of programme monitoring and reporting information.

- Conduct periodic reviews and verification of programme results data, including source documentation, institutional records and other means of verification, and recommend corrective measures where data-quality issues are identified.

- Provide technical guidance and capacity-development support to designated other team members and relevant partners on results-based management, indicator measurement, monitoring tools, data collection, data quality, analysis and use of evidence.

- Support relevant institutional partners in strengthening monitoring, data-management and results-reporting practices, where appropriate, to improve the availability and quality of evidence supporting programme results.

- Promote consistent application of monitoring standards, methodologies, definitions and reporting practices across programme interventions to strengthen comparability and reliability of results information.

- Identify monitoring and evaluation risks, data gaps and evidence limitations and recommend practical measures to address them.

4.Coordinate evaluations, assessments, surveys and research for programme learning and accountability.

- Provide technical leadership and coordination for programme evaluations, assessments, surveys, studies and other evidence-generation initiatives in accordance with programme requirements and applicable UNDP standards.

- Prepare and/or review terms of reference, methodologies, data-collection tools, sampling approaches, analytical frameworks and other technical documentation for monitoring, evaluation, survey and research assignments.

- Provide technical oversight and quality assurance for consultants, research organisations and service providers engaged for specialised monitoring, evaluation, assessment, survey and research assignments.

- Review evaluation, assessment and research deliverables to ensure methodological rigour, appropriate use of evidence, analytical quality and consistency with agreed requirements.

- Facilitate appropriate management responses, follow-up and use of evaluation and assessment findings and recommendations to strengthen programme performance and accountability.

- Promote gender-responsive and inclusive evaluation and research approaches, including appropriate disaggregation of evidence and consideration of differential results and experiences among women and vulnerable and marginalised populations.

5.Ensure M&E quality assurance and contribute to programme planning and management.

- Provide technical advice to the Chief Technical Advisor on programme performance, results achievement, evidence gaps, monitoring risks and areas requiring management attention or course correction.

- Review relevant programme workplans, results frameworks, technical documents and implementation arrangements from a monitoring and results perspective and provide recommendations to strengthen measurability and results orientation.

- Provide M&E and results-based inputs to programme planning, reviews, management meetings, briefing notes, presentations and other programme documentation, as required.

- Support the establishment and periodic review of appropriate monitoring arrangements for programme interventions to ensure that expected results can be credibly measured and reported.

- Maintain organised and accessible monitoring, evaluation and reporting records, datasets, evidence and supporting documentation to facilitate programme management, reporting, reviews, evaluations and assurance processes.

- Capture and promote lessons from programme monitoring and evaluation to strengthen implementation quality, institutional learning and future programming.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Institutional Arrangement

The Rule of Law Programme is placed within the Democratic Governance Unit of the UNDP Country Office in Pakistan, and the Analyst will work under the supervision of the Team Lead – Programme Specialist and coordinate with designated other team members and relevant Country Office colleagues.

jobs.title: Project Travel and Logistics Associate (Open to internal and external applicants)
jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Office/Unit/Project Description

UNDP’s Rule of Law Programme in Pakistan is working to strengthen the rule of law and to ensure equal access to justice and security services, particularly for women and marginalized groups across Pakistan in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP) including the merged districts (MDs), Balochistan, and Islamabad Capital Territory (ICT). In close collaboration with a range of government, rule of law and justice sector institutions, the overall Programme aims to enhance and sustain peace and stability for the longer-term in Pakistan.

The Programme activities and interventions therefore directly correspond with the government of Pakistan’s strategies and commitments to rule of law and justice reforms, as well as improving the efficiency and effectiveness of institutions to deliver accountable and affordable security and justice services to the public.

The Rule of Law Programme implementation is guided by the following four strategic objectives:

- Policy, legal and regulatory frameworks strengthened to warrant people-centered, equitable, timely, affordable justice and security delivery to all people with an emphasis on women, marginalized and vulnerable groups, and digital technologies.

- Capacity of justice and security stakeholders (duty bearers) enhanced to deliver inclusive, timely, and accessible services to all people with an emphasis on women and digital technologies.

- Capacity of women, and the most vulnerable and marginalized (rights holders) strengthened to access referral pathways to justice and security.

- Justice and security sector institutional facilities enhanced to deliver inclusive, timely, and accessible justice and security services, through women friendly and gender-responsive infrastructure development support with an emphasis on flood resilience and green energy.

Against this backdrop, UNDP actions and interventions are aimed at restoring public confidence and service delivery in the formal justice and rule of law sectors through a range of initiatives i.e. policy development and reform, fostering justice and security sector governance, as well as oversight and accountability at an institutional level with emphasis on inclusive and gender-responsive programming. The overall engagement strategy, therefore, involves both federal and local levels. The Programme is implemented in partnership with the Judiciary, Police, Prosecution, Prisons, Probation and Reclamation, Bar Associations, Civil Society Organizations (CSOs) and the academia both at federal and provincial levels.

The Project Travel and Logistics Associate will provide dedicated travel, mission, event-logistics and related administrative support for Rule of Law Programme activities. The Associate will facilitate timely and efficient arrangements for official travel, field missions, trainings, workshops, consultations, conferences and other programme activities in accordance with applicable UNDP policies and procedures.

The Associate will support travel planning and processing, logistical arrangements, travel documentation and claims, participant coordination, service-provider liaison and maintenance of accurate administrative records. S/he will contribute to smooth programme implementation by ensuring that travel and logistical requirements are anticipated, coordinated and followed through in a timely, accurate and service-oriented manner.

Scope of Work

Under the supervision of the Team Lead – Programme Specialist, the Travel and Logistics Associate will provide day-to-day travel, mission and event-logistics support for programme activities. The Associate will coordinate closely with programme personnel, operations colleagues, institutional counterparts and service providers to ensure timely, accurate and compliant arrangements.

The Associate will be responsible for the following functions:

a) Coordinate travel and mission arrangements.

- Process and coordinate official travel arrangements for programme personnel, consultants and other authorised travelers in accordance with UNDP travel policies and procedures.

- Support preparation and processing of travel requests, travel plans, itineraries, tickets, accommodation, terminal arrangements and other required travel documentation.

- Liaise with authorised travel service providers and relevant UNDP units to obtain appropriate travel options and facilitate timely issuance and amendment of travel arrangements.

- Support coordination of security-related travel requirements and ensure that required traveler and mission information is provided to the relevant focal points in a timely manner.

- Maintain an up-to-date travel and mission calendar and follow up on pending approvals, documentation and arrangements that may affect planned travel.

- Provide travelers with relevant administrative and logistical information before missions and support resolution of travel-related issues during implementation, as required.

b) Support travel claims, documentation and financial follow-up.

- Support travelers in completing required post-travel documentation and travel claims and check submissions for completeness before further processing.

- Maintain organised records of travel authorisations, itineraries, tickets, boarding passes, claims and other required supporting documentation in accordance with applicable record-management requirements.

- Coordinate with the Operations & Finance Analyst on travel budgets, advances, claims, reconciliations and other financial matters related to missions and programme travel.

- Follow up on outstanding travel documentation, advances and claims and support timely closure of completed travel actions.

- Maintain travel trackers and provide periodic information on travel status, costs, pending actions and completed missions for programme monitoring and planning.

c) Coordinate logistics for programme events and activities.

- Coordinate logistical arrangements for programme workshops, trainings, consultations, conferences, meetings and other events in collaboration with programme colleagues and institutional counterparts.

- Arrange venues, accommodation, local transportation, participant travel, interpretation, audiovisual equipment, printing, catering and other logistical services, as required and in accordance with applicable procedures.

- Support participant registration, attendance records, travel information, logistical communications and other administrative requirements for programme events.

- Coordinate logistical requirements with designated other team members while ensuring clear sequencing between substantive event planning and logistical arrangements.

- Liaise with vendors and service providers on approved logistical requirements and monitor timely delivery of agreed services, escalating issues to the responsible colleagues where necessary.

- Provide on-site logistical support during programme events and missions and facilitate timely resolution of practical and administrative issues.

d) Provide logistical and administrative support to programme implementation.

- Support arrangements for programme meetings, field visits, delegations and official visits, including schedules, transportation, accommodation and related logistics.

- Coordinate vehicle and transportation requirements for programme missions and activities with relevant UNDP service providers and administrative units.

- Support receipt, dispatch and movement of programme materials, documents and equipment associated with missions and events, as required.

- Maintain organised logistical records, service-provider information, contact lists and other administrative documentation needed for programme implementation.

- Support designated other team members with routine administrative coordination related to missions, events and field activities and ensure timely follow-up on agreed actions.

- Contribute to practical contingency arrangements for missions and events, particularly where travel conditions, security requirements or operational constraints may affect implementation.

e) Ensure compliance, coordination, service quality and effective records management.

- Ensure travel and logistical arrangements are processed in accordance with UNDP policies, procedures, applicable entitlements and approved programme budgets.

- Coordinate with designated other team members and relevant Country Office operations and administrative units to ensure appropriate sequencing, documentation and timely completion of travel and logistics actions.

- Provide relevant specifications, schedules and service information where procurement action is required for travel or logistical services.

- Monitor the quality and timeliness of travel and logistics services and promptly flag recurring service issues, operational risks or delays requiring attention.

- Provide travel and logistics information for programme workplans, implementation reviews, reports and management updates, as required.

- Keep abreast of relevant changes in UNDP travel and administrative procedures and support their consistent application within the Programme.

f) Support knowledge building, knowledge sharing and capacity building relevant to the project.

- Participate in training and organize briefings on internal procedures for the project personnel. Provide support to other capacity building activities, including to the design and delivery of tools, materials for workshops, or platforms that tap into the collective intelligence of communities and mobilize action.

- Provide support in the dissemination and sharing of relevant data and lessons learned within the CO and regionally. Keep pulse on emerging best practices nationally, regionally, and internationally that relate to the work of the project.

- Make sound contributions to knowledge networks and communities of practice. Support compiling and systematizing project knowledge, products and tools as well as their wide distribution to partners.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Institutional Arrangement

The Travel and Logistics Associate will be based in the UNDP Pakistan Country Office in Islamabad, with travel to programme implementation locations, particularly Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan, as required.

Under the supervision of the Team Lead – Programme Specialist, the Associate will provide dedicated travel, mission, event-logistics and related administrative support for programme activities.

The Associate will work closely with programme colleagues, including technical specialists, provincial teams, as well as relevant UNDP Country Office operations and administrative units and approved service providers, to ensure timely, efficient and compliant travel and logistical arrangements.

LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible

Ability to effectively plan, organise and oversee different parts of corporate operations, simultaneously and in an integrated way, in order to convert the organisation’s assets into the best results in the most efficient way. Knowledge of relevant concepts and mechanisms.

Ability to manage communications internally and externally, through media, social media and other appropriate channels.

- Secondary education is required.

- A university degree (Bachelor’s degree) in Business Administration, Public Administration, Management, Logistics, Travel and Tourism, Social Sciences or a related field will be given due consideration, but is not a requirement.

Min. years of relevant Work experience

- A minimum of 7 years (with secondary education) or 4 years (with bachelor’s degree) of relevant experience in travel administration, logistics, event support, programme administration or related areas is required.

Required Skills

- Experience coordinating official travel, including itineraries, tickets, accommodation, travel documentation and travel claims.

- Experience providing logistical support for workshops, trainings, conferences, meetings or field missions.

- Experience in the use of computers, office software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc.) and web-based management systems, and advanced knowledge of spreadsheet and database packages.

- Experience coordinating with travel agencies, hotels, transport providers, venues and other service providers.

- Experience supporting travel claims, advances, reconciliations or related financial documentation.

- Experience arranging participant travel and logistics for large or multi-location programme activities.

- Experience working in accordance with organisational travel, administrative and financial procedures.

- Experience coordinating travel and logistics in complex field environments or locations with operational and security constraints.

- Experience with enterprise resource planning, travel-management or administrative systems is desirable; familiarity with UNDP Quantum or comparable systems.
